tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search Hong Kong companies by Chinese/English name keyword or 7-digit CR number. Works WITHOUT an API key (15 free searches/day per IP; 50/day with free API key; 300/day for paid users). Returns matching list with legal names, CR number, active/dissolved status, incorporation date, and entity type.
